# telnyx_whatsapp_user_data (Resource)

The account-wide WhatsApp settings of your Telnyx account, the webhook URLs that receive WhatsApp signup events. There is one per account; creating this resource adopts it and destroying it leaves its values as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The webhooks that receive WhatsApp signup events. There is one per account;
# destroy leaves its values as they are.
resource "telnyx_whatsapp_user_data" "this" {
  webhook_url          = "https://example.com/webhooks/whatsapp-signup"
  webhook_failover_url = "https://backup.example.com/webhooks/whatsapp-signup"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `webhook_failover_url` (String) Failover URL to receive Whatsapp signup events
- `webhook_url` (String) URL to receive Whatsapp signup events

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Always whatsapp_user_data: there is one per account.
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_user_data.this whatsapp_user_data
```
